posts.cooked:
Hello everyone! I didn't feel this worth making a thread for, but thought some people may have been curious why there has been a significant lack of Ronway the last couple of years.

The primary reason being my 8 year relationship came to an end 2 years ago. While it was certainly for the best, it did hit me fairly hard, largely because I met her at the tail end of High School so my entire adult life was with her. So it was a huge shift as to who the adult me is, which is still an ongoing search honestly. While the initial disappearance was because my life was coming apart I did eventually work my way out of it.

Now the reason I don't come on nearly as much I did is because I do a lot of things outside of just being on the computer. Now i'm not shaming anyone that does that, heck there are days I miss sitting at the computer for hours, playing SotM on Google+ or conversing with those on the forums. Last year I took my son, sister, and mother out to Saint Louis. I've actually started college last week. I joined another game group in person that meets up every other week. 

I'm probably happier now than I have been in quite some time. And if any of you are going through some rough times I hope you'll be able to work through them and become stronger because of it.

Thank you to everyone that has been a part of my life.

-Ronway
